notes.title: Droid Assault 1.91.8 Released
notes.content:
Very minor tweaks here, but hopefully appreciated:

[list]
[*] You should be seeing the Super Health a lot more often now
[*] Ordinary health pickups now repair your droid max hitpoints by 12.5% 
[*] Droids which have no use of bouncy bullets or sharp bullets (eg. the disruptor weapons and flamers) won't be able to pick those powerups up
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Ordinary health pickups now repair your droid max hitpoints by 12.5%
- Droids which have no use of bouncy bullets or sharp bullets (eg. the disruptor weapons and flamers) won't be able to pick those powerups up
